function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

Sure! I’ll give you two quick ways to get a reminder set for **March 27** so you don’t forget your Netflix subscription renewal: --- ### 📅 Option 1 – Add a Calendar Event Manually | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **Windows Calendar / Microsoft Outlook** | 1️⃣ Open *Calendar*.
2️⃣ Click “New event” (or double‑click the day).
3️⃣ Title: `Netflix Subscription Renewal`.
4️⃣ Date & Time: **Mar 27**, choose a time that works for you.
5️⃣ Set a reminder alert (e.g., 10 min before).
6️⃣ Save. | | **Google Calendar** | 1️⃣ Go to [calendar.google.com](https://calendar.google.com).
2️⃣ Click “Create”.
3️⃣ Fill in title, date/time, and click “Add notifications” → e.g., “Email at 9 am”, “Pop‑up 15 minutes before”.
4️⃣ Hit “Save.” | Once added, both calendars will pop up a notification when the date arrives—no extra effort required! --- ### ⏰ Option 2 – Use Windows Task Scheduler (automatic popup) If you’d rather let Windows handle it automatically without opening a calendar app, follow these steps: 1. Press **Win + R**, type `taskschd.msc`, hit Enter to launch Task Scheduler. 2. In the right pane, click **“Create Basic Task…”**. 3. Name it `Netflix_Subscription_Reminder`. 4. Choose **Daily** trigger, then set start date to **03/27/YYYY** (replace YYYY with current year) and repeat once. 5. Action → **Start a program**. Browse to `C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe`. - Arguments: `shell32.dll,Control_RunDLL timedate.cpl,,0` *(this opens the Clock & Region settings)* — optional, replace with a custom script if you prefer.* 6. Finish setup. You’ll receive a toast notification from Windows on Mar 27. *(Tip: If you’re comfortable writing a small PowerShell script that shows a balloon tip, you can point the action above to that script instead.)* --- #### Quick Reminder Text (copy/paste into notes): ``` 📌 Remember: Renew Netflix subscription on March 27! ✅ Check payment method ➜ ✅ Update billing info ➜ ✅ Enjoy streaming 🎬 ``` Feel free to paste that into OneNote, Sticky Notes, or even as a desktop wallpaper reminder. Let me know if you'd like help automating anything else—or if you prefer another platform!
